## Prices and dates

Group tour from 11 to 21 August 2027, 11 days / 10 nights. The programme operates from 1 traveller; the group has no more than 15 participants.

| Accommodation | Price per person |
|---|---:|
| Triple (TPL) | 3665 USD |
| Double (DBL) | 3745 USD |
| Single (SGL) | 4565 USD |

The price includes mainland Ecuador and the Galápagos Islands. The Quito — Galápagos Islands — Guayaquil flight is paid separately: 575 USD per person, subject to change until ticketing. The Galápagos National Park fee is 200 USD; children under 12 receive a 50% discount, and the fee is subject to change. The Galápagos tourist card is included.

## Route

Quito and the Equator Line — Cotopaxi Valley, a rose plantation and Tigua — Quilotoa crater lake — Baños and waterfalls — Quito — Galápagos Islands — Guayaquil — Punta Centinela.

On Santa Cruz, you will visit the highlands with giant tortoises and lava tunnels. The next day is dedicated to Bartolomé, followed by a day on North Seymour with Las Bachas or South Plaza with Punta Carrión. The final three nights are at Decameron Punta Centinela on the Pacific coast, with a free day and a boat trip to see humpback whales.

## Hotels and meals

Quito — Finlandia 4*, Baños — La Floresta 3*, Galápagos — Fiesta 3*, coast — Decameron Punta Centinela (3 nights, all inclusive). Hotels may be replaced by others of a similar category.

Dinner with your guide is included on the first evening. Breakfast is included on days 2–4; breakfast and lunch on days 5–7. The coastal stay is all inclusive.

## Guides and transfers

An English-speaking guide accompanies you on mainland Ecuador and in the Galápagos. The first transfer in Quito is with an English-speaking driver. The final transfer in the Galápagos and the Guayaquil airport — Decameron — airport transfers are with a Spanish-speaking driver, without a guide. Whale watching is organised through the hotel without a separate guide, with specialists accompanying you on the boat.
